data.body: Fixed: Moved gh pr merge --auto --merge out of _phase_merge and into a new _phase_queue_auto_merge helper. The new helper is called in the top-level flow AFTER _phase_resolve_threads succeeds (plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh, top-level section). If thread resolution fails or escalates, auto-merge is never queued. The auto_merge_disabled fallthrough path is preserved in _phase_queue_auto_merge. Also added regression test t_pr_auto_merge_queued_after_thread_resolution that inspects the gh argv log to confirm the pr view (resolve-threads) call appears before the pr merge --auto call.
